name: More Checkpoints
description: Automatically places practice-mode checkpoints on a timer, so you don't have to spam the checkpoint key.

checkpoint-interval.name: Checkpoint Interval (seconds)
checkpoint-interval.description: How often a new checkpoint is placed automatically while in practice mode.

max-checkpoints.name: Max Stored Checkpoints
max-checkpoints.description: Oldest checkpoints are removed once this limit is passed, so memory/backups don't grow forever. Set to 0 for unlimited.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn automatic checkpoint placement on or off without uninstalling the mod.
